item.text: The main defect is the existing single-type helper: Ubuntu resolves to `Ubuntu`, while Gost stores its richer record under `UbuntuAPI`. The same single-family assumption appears in URLs, field ordering, summaries, and CVSS v3. I’m checking the change-detection call sites and function signatures now so the new mapping is used consistently without breaking existing callers.
